title: 第十章 博九秦漠正式相遇2
slug: 国民校草是女生全本免费-国民校草是女生最新章节列表
content_zh:
那样的笑，怎么说呢，忒撩人了！
被打招呼的妹子们立刻捧住了自己的脸，烫的！
陈晓东就在走在博九的身后，一副见了鬼的表情：“少爷，你在……你在朝着妹子们放电！？”
博九挑眉：“有问题吗？妹子们这么萌。”
“你不是说你天生爱男人吗！？”陈晓东压低了声音。
博九慵懒懒的反问：“这和我朝着妹子放电有关系吗？“
陈晓东：……他竟然无言以对！
可是，少爷你是什么时候学会的撩妹，你以前讨厌女孩子讨厌的恨不得看了她们就跑。
你看看你现在！
简直就是个摧花高手！
博九毫不在意旁人怎么看她，尤其是她的同桌蒋飞扬看见博九对妹子们的态度之后，真的是眼睛都睁大了！
这个小弱渣到底是怎么回事？
是想抢人女朋友吗？
蒋飞扬的眸子冒着火，看样子又想不安分。
博九把书包随手扔在了那，就那么单手插着口袋看着他。
只见蒋飞扬的气场越来越弱，越来越弱……最后脖子一缩，给博九让开了去路。
“呵。”博九低笑了一声，坐到座位上之后，拆了一根棒棒糖放进了嘴里，颇有纨绔少爷的模样。
蒋飞扬放在桌子上的拳头攥了攥，始终没有挥下去，因为他实在是打不过对方。
为什么以前总是追着他跑的小弱渣，会突然之间变成一个魔头？这日子简直没法过了！
013班的第一帅哥还在苦恼着，英语老师已经从外面走了进来。

博九一看是她擅长的科目，手指从课桌下一动，就把准备好的平板和键盘抽了出来。
英语课本竖着，遮挡住了平板，键盘就放在课桌里面，反正她会盲打，也不需要低头。
单击进入游戏页面。
博九还没有去公告里接单，就看见上次申请加她为好友的消息还留在那。
她刚想继续点拒绝，旁边的蒋飞扬却在瞄到她平板页面时，控制不住的叫了起来：“秦！秦少！”
这个称呼像是旋风一般席卷了整个教室。
“他刚刚说谁？秦少？”
“秦少来了吗？！“
“怎么可能！没有学校的邀约，男神是不会总在学校里走动的，一年都见不了两次好么！”
“那蒋帅哥刚刚叫的是谁？”
“不知道啊，到底怎么回事？”
蒋飞扬手指还在指着博九的课本，实际上是那下面的平板，嘴唇都有点哆嗦了：“秦少他……”
“老师！”还没等蒋飞扬把话说完，博九就开口打断了他，双眸看着台上：“蒋飞扬在课堂上胡乱吵闹，明显是不尊师重道。“
英语老师早就气的额上冒青筋儿了，现在一听博九的话，立刻道：“其他同学先自习，蒋飞杨，你跟我来办公室一趟！“
蒋飞杨真是无比的冤，指了指博九，又对着英语老师着急的说：“不是，老师，是他……”
“他怎么了？”英语老师踱步走了过来，目光放在了博九竖着的课本上。
然后，伸手一扬……
喜欢国民校草是女生请大家
content_en:
That smile, how should I put it, is so sultry!
The girls who were greeted immediately held their faces in their hands, it was so hot!
Chen Xiaodong was walking behind Bo Jiu with an expression as if he had seen a ghost: "Master, are you... are you firing electricity at the girls!?"
Bo Jiu raised his eyebrows: "Is there a problem? Girls are so cute."
"Didn't you say that you are born to love men!?" Chen Xiaodong lowered his voice.
Bo Jiu lazily asked, "Does this have anything to do with my discharge of electricity towards the girl?"
Chen Xiaodong: ...He was speechless!
But, Master, when did you learn how to flirt with girls? You used to hate girls so much that you wanted to run away after just looking at them.
Look at you now!
He is simply a master of destroying flowers!
Bo Jiu didn't care what others thought of her, especially her deskmate Jiang Feiyang, whose eyes really widened after seeing Bo Jiu's attitude towards the girls!
What happened to this little weakling?
Are you trying to steal someone's girlfriend?
Jiang Feiyang's eyes were on fire, and he seemed restless again.
Bo Jiu threw his schoolbag there and just looked at him with one hand in his pocket.
I saw Jiang Feiyang's aura getting weaker and weaker... Finally, he shrank his neck and made way for Bo Jiu.
"Ha." Bo Jiu chuckled. After sitting on his seat, he opened a lollipop and put it in his mouth, looking like a dandy young master.
Jiang Feiyang clenched his fist on the table and never swung it because he really couldn't beat the opponent.
Why did the little weakling who always chased him suddenly turn into a demon? This day is simply unbearable!
The most handsome boy in Class 013 was still worried, but the English teacher had already walked in from outside.
As soon as Bo Jiu saw that it was a subject she was good at, she moved her fingers from under the desk and pulled out the prepared tablet and keyboard.
The English textbook was standing upright, covering the tablet, and the keyboard was placed inside the desk. She knew how to touch-type anyway, so she didn't need to lower her head.
Click to enter the game page.
Before Bo Jiu went to the announcement to take the order, she saw that the last application to add her as a friend was still there.
She was just about to continue to refuse, but when Jiang Feiyang next to her glanced at her tablet page, she couldn't help shouting: "Qin! Mr. Qin!"
This title swept through the entire classroom like a whirlwind.
"Who did he just talk about? Mr. Qin?"
"Master Qin is here?!"
"How is that possible! Without an invitation from the school, the male idol will not always walk around the school. We can't see him twice a year, okay?"
"Then who did Handsome Jiang call just now?"
"I don't know, what's going on?"
Jiang Feiyang was still pointing at Bo Jiu's textbook, which was actually the tablet underneath, and his lips were trembling a little: "Young Master Qin..."
"Teacher!" Before Jiang Feiyang could finish his words, Bo Jiu interrupted him, looking at the stage: "Jiang Feiyang made a lot of noise in class, which is obviously disrespectful to teachers."
The English teacher was so angry that veins appeared on his forehead. Now after hearing Bo Jiu's words, he immediately said: "Other students will study by themselves first. Jiang Feiyang, come to the office with me!"
Jiang Feiyang felt extremely wronged. He pointed at Bo Jiu and said anxiously to the English teacher: "No, teacher, it's him..."
"What's wrong with him?" The English teacher walked over and focused on Bo Jiu's textbook.
Then, he raised his hand...
If you like the national school girl, please be a girl.
